packageRules.description: Group both Go references (the GO_VERSION build arg and the exact version asserted in the command test) into one PR, so a bump never lands as a green build arg plus a red test

Automatically merge Go patch releases (security and bug fixes within a minor). Minor bumps are reviewed by hand: Go supports only the last two minors, so a minor is a deliberate move, not a routine one

customManagers.description: Keep the exact Go version asserted by the command test in sync with the GO_VERSION build arg
